params.body: First visits of a detail page still took 3 to 5 s in sign_urls after #200: the fullscreen viewer and the photo anchors sign the original of every photo (twice per photo), and outside production each original costs a HEAD to find out whether it lives under demo/. The viewer now uses the md derivative (960px WebP) like the carousel: no HEADs, and several MB per photo less for everyone, production included. A larger derived size can come as a new generation when wanted.
params.title: Detail viewer on the md derivative
